title: Canadian CT Head Rule
subtitle: CT after selected minor head injury
summary: It is not interchangeable with NICE head-injury guidance and is invalid in several groups, including some anticoagulated patients and patients without the qualifying minor-head-injury syndrome.
population: Confirmed minor head injury with loss of consciousness, amnesia or disorientation; GCS 13–15; exact inclusion and exclusion criteria; five high/medium-risk CT criteria.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: It is not interchangeable with NICE head-injury guidance and is invalid in several groups, including some anticoagulated patients and patients without the qualifying minor-head-injury syndrome.
